items.title: Safety

items:
We’ve curated local artisan furnishings along with our favorite toys (paddleboards, golf carts, private pool and a killer family game closet) in order to create unforgettable beach memories.

With 7 bedrooms (including a carriage house with private entrance), Vibe offers a large sleeping capacity while maintaining its vintage Florida cottage charm.

Walk through the french doors to relax in the (seasonally heated between October 1 and April 30) pool and hot-tub. Grill up some local seafood in our outdoor dining area (which is screened for your pest-free enjoyment). Decompress with a local wine in the master suite’s jacuzzi tub. Or create your gourmet masterpiece in Vibe’s generously-equipped quartz and stainless kitchen.

Not a cookie-cutter subdivision house with zero privacy. Vibe is located on a quiet cul-de-sac in SugarBeach: an upscale neighborhood of custom homes on Florida’s breath-taking 30A. And, Vibe’s ideal location in the center of 30A (only 1.5 miles to the Seaside pavilion) puts our finest beaches, best restaurants, and eclectic boutique shopping only a pleasant stroll away. Of course, our free six-seater golf cart takes the hassle out of carrying your cooler to the beach or parking at our amazing restaurants.

Ever wanted to try paddleboarding? Did you know that our beaches are home to rare Coastal Dune lakes that are found in only three places in the world? Sadly, very few area visitors ever experience the jaw-dropping serenity of paddling through the quiet waters of these natural wonders because they don’t have the means to enjoy them. But that’s no worry for Vibe guests.

Simply strap the two free included paddleboards on our six-seater golf cart to experience either of the two Coastal Dune lakes that are located only a mile from Vibe

This is your opportunity to create memories with family and friends that you will cherish forever. Don’t rent just another beach house. Reserve Vibe’s coastal living experience for your preferred dates before it's too late!

-----------------------------------------------------------
Pool: Vibe's pool is 27 feet long, 14 feet wide, with a shallow end of 3 feet, a deep end of 5 feet, and is seasonally heated from October 1 to April 30.

-----------------------------------------------------------
Parking:
Vibe has parking for up to 6 mid size cars in addition to its two car garage.

-----------------------------------------------------------
Important Information:
NOTE: Check in time is 4:00 PM CST. Check out time is 10:00 AM CST. Our staff needs time to properly clean, sanitize, inspect and maintain the property. Because the property is extremely heavily booked we are unable to offer early check ins, late check outs, early parking or luggage drop offs.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have anything shipped or mailed (through a carrier such as USPS, UPS, or Fedex) to the property. Please be aware that the property does not have postal service and your packages will most likely be returned by the carrier.

NOTE: Guests are not permitted to have local deliveries (such as baby gear, beach chairs/gear, groceries, golf carts) made prior to their check-in time of 4:00 PM CST and are not permitted to have local pick-ups made after their check-out time of 10:00 AM CST.

NOTE: If you would like to reserve more than 11 months in advance, you must use the VRBO website, rather than the VRBO app. The VRBO app only shows the calendar for up to 11 months which means that it can only be used for reservations less than a year away. Parties or events not allowed Thanks!

NOTE: This property is available for vacation rental only. Parties are prohibited.

NOTE: AGE REQUIREMENTS. You must be at least 25 years old to reserve
during Spring Break. Sorry, no exceptions.

NOTE: Sorry, no pets. No emotional support animals (ESA). No exceptions. Many of our Guests have pet allergies and rely on us to provide a pet free environment. Bringing a pet or an emotional support animal (ESA) is a violation of your booking agreement that will result in the cancellation of your reservation without refund.

NOTE: For the safety of our Guests, our golf cart has an Apple Airtag in order to facilitate our ability to assist in the event of an accident or mechanical failure. As a result, Apple Iphone users may occasionally receive Airtag notifications while operating the golf cart.

NOTE: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the house. This includes cigarettes, cigars, marijuana, etc. A $500-1000 additional cleaning charge will be added to remove the smell of smoke from the house.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
